about.subheading: Comfort, Convenience & Genuine Hospitality in Tirupati
about.intro1: Welcome to A A Residency, a modern and comfortable hotel in Tirupati, thoughtfully designed to provide a peaceful and convenient stay for pilgrims, families, business travellers, and guests visiting the city.
about.intro2: Located on Renigunta Road in Auto Nagar, Tirupati, A A Residency offers easy access to the city's key travel routes and is ideally suited for guests visiting Tirumala and other important destinations in and around Tirupati.
about.intro3: At A A Residency, we believe that a good stay is about more than just a comfortable room. It is about cleanliness, thoughtful service, convenience, and making every guest feel welcome. Our well-maintained rooms are designed to give you a relaxing space to unwind after a day of temple visits, travel, or work.
about.section1Title: Designed for Every Kind of Stay
about.section1Para1: Whether you are travelling with family for a pilgrimage, visiting Tirupati with a group, travelling for business, or simply looking for a comfortable overnight stay, our range of rooms provides practical options to suit different needs.
about.section1Para2: Our facilities include air-conditioned rooms, family-friendly accommodation, complimentary Wi-Fi, television, hot water, essential toiletries, elevator access, parking, and 24-hour front-desk assistance.
about.section2Title: A Peaceful Stay with Personal Service
about.section2Para1: We understand that many of our guests visit Tirupati for an important spiritual journey. Our team is committed to making your stay as smooth and comfortable as possible, from check-in to check-out. With a focus on cleanliness, responsive service, and a welcoming atmosphere, we aim to make A A Residency a place where guests can relax and feel at home.
about.section2Para2: Our commitment to guest experience is reflected in the feedback we receive, with guests particularly appreciating our cleanliness, comfortable rooms, friendly staff, and value for money.
about.section3Para1: At A A Residency, our goal is simple — to provide a clean, comfortable, and dependable stay at a value that makes sense.
about.section3Para2: Whether you're here for the blessings of Tirumala, a family trip, a business visit, or simply passing through Tirupati, we look forward to welcoming you and making your stay a pleasant one.
about.tagline: A A Residency — Your comfortable stay in Tirupati!
